silent_recovery.briefing: A small recovery team must cross the mountain corridor, retrieve the sealed cases, disable two marked relays, and exfiltrate before the alarm peaks.

campaign_mission.briefing: Limited force: 3 Wardens and 1 Bulwark. Recover both sealed cases, disable the marked relays, then extract one Warden back through the west route.

detection.failure_message: The recovery team stayed exposed too long.

phases.description: Recover both sealed cases. Use the mountain passes and the repair stations to keep the limited force moving.
Destroy the two marked relay nodes before the patrol net closes.
Return at least one Warden to the west extraction zone.
phases.completion_message: The recovery team is clear. Silent Recovery complete.

long_road.briefing: Escort a Mobile Command Unit through the mountain corridor and deploy a Forward Base at the marked eastern pad.

campaign_mission.briefing: Keep the Mobile Command Unit moving through a defined mountain pass. Once it reaches the eastern deployment zone, deploy the Forward Base and hold the site during construction.

phases.description: Move the Mobile Command Unit to the deployment pad.
phases.completion_message: Deployment pad reached. Select the carrier and press DEPLOY BASE.

phases.description: Deploy the Forward Base and protect it until the construction cycle completes.
phases.completion_message: Forward Base established. Holdfast is ready.

holdfast.briefing: The Forward Base is online with a nearby Energy Field, Resource Processor, and Assembly Bay. Build a defensive perimeter, then hold the mountain corridor against five escalating assault waves.

campaign_mission.briefing: Use the deployed base as the anchor for a layered defence. Keep the local Collector route running, spend its income on the perimeter and reinforcements, then survive five escalating assault waves.

phases.description: Build two defensive structures around the Forward Base, then use Processor income to reinforce the line.
phases.completion_message: The perimeter is active. Keep the Collector route running and prepare for contact.

phases.description: Protect the Forward Base through five escalating assault waves. Keep the local Collector delivering energy for towers and reinforcements; the final pushes include armoured and missile threats.
phases.completion_message: The Forward Base held through the full assault.

network_sever.briefing: The Frontier has turned the Central Relay into a counter-offensive anchor. The western relay chain is ready; capture the hub, keep the link connected, and hold the network online while mobile raiders push back through the Crossroads.

campaign_mission.briefing: Capture Central Relay and keep it connected for 90 seconds. Progress is retained while the link is online, but contested territory drains the clock and the Frontier counter-attacks in escalating waves.

phases.description: Capture Central Relay and keep the connected network online. If the relay is contested, progress decays while the counter-offensive closes in.
phases.completion_message: Central Relay held. The Frontier network has been severed.

ai.intent_message: Contest Central Relay and break the connected network before the Coalition can stabilize its hold.
ai.map_tactic_message: The Frontier will pressure the relay chain rather than waiting for an HQ assault.
